description: Water utility decision support ontology, rules and validation data is a data set deposited in Cardiff University by its authors S K Howell, Y Rezgui. The dataset involves an ontology and rule base, developed with industry experts and instantiated from GIS, sensor, and EPANET data for a Welsh pilot. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: Image. Size stated: <1GB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
